description:
The Huffy Incline 24" Mountain Bike is ready for riders who want to explore farther and ride with confidence. Whether cruising through the neighborhood, tackling park paths, or discovering new routes, its mountain-inspired design encourages adventure while delivering the durability needed for everyday fun.
With 21-speed Shimano shifting, riders can easily adapt to changing terrain, from gentle climbs to fast straightaways. A front suspension fork helps absorb bumps along the way, creating a smoother, more comfortable ride across sidewalks, trails, and uneven paths.
Wide all-terrain tires provide steady traction on a variety of surfaces, while front and rear hand brakes deliver responsive stopping control when it matters most. A padded comfort saddle supports longer rides, and the included kickstand makes it easy to park after every adventure.

components.description: Dual hand brakes: front and rear linear pull brakes provide responsive stopping.
wide tires grip sidewalks, trails, and park paths.
